1.w: My child, be attentive to my wisdom; pay close attention to my understanding,

2.w: in order to safeguard discretion and that your lips may guard knowledge.

3.w: For the lips of the adulterous woman drip honey, and her seductive words are smoother than olive oil,

4.w: but in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

5.w: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.

6.w: Lest she should make level the path leading to life, her paths have wandered, but she is not able to discern it.

7.w: So now, children, listen to me; do not turn aside from the words I speak.

8.w: Keep yourself far from her, and do not go near the door of her house,

9.w: lest you give your vigor to others and your years to a cruel person,

10.w: lest strangers devour your strength and your labor benefit another man’s house.

11.w: And at the end of your life you will groan when your flesh and your body are wasted away.

12.w: And you will say, “How I hated discipline! My heart spurned reproof!

13.w: For I did not obey my teachers, and I did not heed my instructors.

14.w: I almost came to complete ruin in the midst of the whole congregation!”

15.w: Drink water from your own cistern and running water from your own well.

16.w: Should your springs be dispersed outside, your streams of water in the wide plazas?

17.w: Let them be for yourself alone and not for strangers with you.

18.w: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife you married in your youth —

19.w: a loving doe, a graceful deer; may her breasts satisfy you at all times; may you be captivated by her love always.

20.w: But why should you be captivated, my son, by an adulteress, and embrace the bosom of a different woman?

21.w: For the ways of a person are in front of the Lord’s eyes, and the Lord weighs all that person’s paths.

22.w: The wicked will be captured by his own iniquities, and he will be held by the cords of his own sin.

23.w: He will die because there was no discipline; because of the greatness of his folly he will reel.
